title: Working Student – Laser Lab & Cleanroom Operations (f/m/d)
description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial

fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global

fusion industry - we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and

engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial

scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that

promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

YOUR ROLE

Focused Energy seeks a Working Student - Laser Lab & Cleanroom Operations (f/m/d) for our Laser Lab in Darmstadt to support laser experiment design and setup. You will assist with cleanroom operations, including preparing and inspecting optical components, setting up support systems, electronics, and measurement equipment, and helping commission cooling and driver units. After setup, you will operate experiments and collect data. This immersive, hands-on role involves daily collaboration with lab and controls engineers in a cleanroom, requiring precision, adherence to

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Assist the Laser Lab team in designing and building laser experiments in the Darmstadt Optical Lab.

- Support cleanroom operations by setting up support systems and preparing components.

- Clean and inspect optical and mechanical components according to cleanroom standards.

- Set up electronics and measurement equipment for experiments.

- Collaborate with engineers to commission cooling and driver units.

- Operate experiments and collect data under engineering supervision.

- Adhere to cleanroom and lab safety protocols, and promptly report any deviations.

WHO YOU ARE

- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physics, Optics/Photonics, Laser Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

- You possess a basic understanding of optics, lasers, or experimental physics through coursework or laboratory experience.

- Comfortable with hands-on hardware work, demonstrating careful, precise, and methodical handling of sensitive components.

- Able to reliably follow structured procedures and safety protocols (such as cleanroom or laboratory guidelines).

- Basic familiarity with electronics and measurement equipment, such as oscilloscopes, power meters, or similar devices.

- You demonstrate reliability, a structured and proactive approach, and a willingness to learn in a hands-on laboratory environment.

- Strong English skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

- Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

- Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

- Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

- Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

- Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

- Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

- Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

- Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboar

ABOUT GMR MARKETING

We are the Experience Agency Making Unforgettable Stories Born of Humanity

NOT JUST EXPERIENTIAL. EXPERIENCE.

The lines have blurred. People live in the physical, digital, and social worlds all at once, and your brand experiences should do the same.

NOT JUST TELLING. MAKING.

The best stories are lived, not heard. Make an immersive world for people to explore so they can experience something they’ll never forget.

It all starts with the human. If you want to make a lasting impact, look beyond the wallet to understand what motivates and inspires people.

You know when to push a concept further, when to challenge the expected, and how to turn a strong creative direction into something people can actually experience. You bring a deep understanding of materials, spatial design, and the technical details that make ambitious ideas work in the real world.
Your 3D thinking helps shape more than individual projects. It helps shape entire campaigns. You’ll work alongside Design Directors, Creative Directors, and production specialist, bringing your perspective to the table and pushing what’s possible in spatial design. Make the vision feel real. You’ll create photorealistic renderings that capture the full experience, including lighting, materials, human scale, atmosphere, and brand narrative. Your work doesn’t simply visualize an idea; it makes people believe in it.

•
Shape the creative direction. You’ll partner with Creative Directors and Design Directors to translate ideas into space, challenge assumptions, and push concepts into new territory. You understand that spatial design is more than aesthetics. It shapes how people move, interact, experience, and remember a brand.

•
Take ideas all the way to reality. You’ll move ambitious concepts into production through technical development, production documentation, fabrication, and installation. You understand what happens when a design leaves the screen and enters the physical world, and you know how to design for that moment. A deep understanding of materials, fabrication methods, environmental design, and real-world performance is essential.

•
Build cohesive experiences. You’ll collaborate with 2D and Motion Designers to connect spatial design to the larger visual system, creating brand experiences that feel considered and cohesive from every angle.

•
Present with confidence. You’ll lead complex client presentations, communicate spatial concepts clearly, and make a compelling case for your creative decisions. You know how to bring people into the vision and take them along for the ride.

Master your tools and keep exploring. You bring expert level proficiency in Cinema 4D, SketchUp, AutoCAD, and/or Rhino, along with experience using rendering plugins and AI enabled workflows. title: API Product Manager
description:
Accertify enables commerce by doing one thing extraordinarily well: pinpointing fraud. The company's Predictive Yes Platform helps businesses say yes to more - more good customers, more revenue, and more growth - without getting burned. It's a precise, confident, data-backed yes, made possible by joining signals across the entire customer lifecycle through unmatched data volume, layered AI-powered models, and a consortium approach that protects clients from bad actors spotted anywhere in the network while unlocking business with good actors verified anywhere in the network. With more than 10 billion transactions and over $1 trillion in commerce processed in 2025 alone, Accertify delivers the intelligence and precision that fraud and payments teams need to say yes confidently and enable growth. That's the More Yes difference.

As an API Product Manager, you own how the world connects to Accertify : our APIs, our partner integrations, and the data validation providers that feed our decisioning. Integration speed directly affects revenue, data provider quality directly affects our models, and developer experience directly affects how our clients feel about working with us. You'll be accountable for all three.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

•
Own the API product lifecycle. Strategy, roadmap, design, delivery, and performance. You decide what we build and in what order, and you're accountable for improving integration speed and time-to-revenue.

•
Run the public API developer portal. Keep documentation clear, current, and complete so clients can integrate quickly with minimal hand-holding from client services.

•
Manage partner integrations. Own our integrations with platforms like Shopify and Salesforce, keeping them compatible, scalable, and aligned with where our fraud and identity solutions are headed. Beyond today's integrations, identify and prioritize other platforms and marketplaces where our customers transact, and build the case for where we should show up next.

Own our data validation service providers. Manage the portfolio of vendors that supply identity verification, email and phone intelligence, address validation, and device signals to our decisioning. Evaluate new providers, monitor performance, coverage, and cost, hold vendors to their SLAs, and decide when to add or replace one.

•
Partner across the business. Work with engineering, client services, sales, and partnerships to support enterprise client integrations, and serve as the go-to voice for Accertify 's API capabilities internally and externally.

•
Decide with data. Track API usage, adoption, integration timelines, vendor SLAs, and developer satisfaction, and use them to drive product decisions.

What Success Looks Like

• Enterprise clients integrate in weeks, and time-to-revenue measurably shrinks.

• Developers describe our documentation as the best in the fraud space, unprompted.

• Our data validation provider portfolio is deliberately curated: every vendor earns its place on performance and cost, and we're never surprised by a degradation.

• Partner integrations are an asset our sales team leads with.

Skills & Qualifications

• 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in fraud, identity, payments, or SaaS platforms.

• Understanding of RESTful APIs, authentication protocols (OAuth, SAML), and what makes a developer ecosystem work.

• Experience managing third-party vendors and partner relationships, and know how to identify the partnerships that compound in value.

• Experience managing data providers. You know that coverage, match rates, latency, and cost per lookup all matter, and you know how to hold a vendor accountable to an SLA.

• Communication with equal fluency to a staff engineer and a CFO, and you raise hard conversations early.

• Experience translating customer and partner needs into scalable, reusable solutions.

title: Network Design and System Integration Engineer
description:
Role Description
We are looking for a Network Design and Systems Integration Engineer. You will be part of a distributed team of like-minded professionals whose day-to-day job is to support our broadband solutions rollout, from early pre-sales engagements with potential customers through production deployment.
You will report to the Director, Broadband System Integration. You will be required to work on key customer account(s) in North American time zones.
Location
Remote - this position is 100% Remote anywhere in Canada and occasional travel is required (up to 50%)
What you will be doing:
• Own the design, integration, and testing of broadband access systems - turning architecture drawings into working IP network solutions and detailed customer installation and integration plans.
• Act as the key technical liaison on customer projects: communicate solution requirements to internal teams and clients, provide clear technical direction, and take ownership of tasks end-to-end.
• Support client lab integration, testing, qualification, field trials, and production deployments of our access network platform; train clients on system operation and troubleshooting.
• Test new software and hardware, and report and track defects to engineering.
• Provide on-site and remote technical support - diagnosing and resolving customer issues in a timely manner, escalating through Harmonic 's 24/7 Technical Assistance Center (TAC) as needed.
What you should have:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, or equivalent.
• 5+ years of experience integrating, testing, or operating networks in an internet service provider or telecommunications environment.
• Understanding of service provider network and service design is a plus.
• Strong expertise in IP routing (BGP, OSPF), Layer 2 technologies (VLAN/802.1Q, QinQ, LACP, MSTP), network overlays (VXLAN, MPLS), IP multicast (IGMP, PIM), and vBNG functions (subscriber management, PPPoE/IPoE, QoS enforcement), including design, configuration, and troubleshooting.
• Strong Linux networking skills and the ability to troubleshoot routing, interfaces, packet captures, firewalls, tunnels, timing, and performance issues.
• Experience with Wireshark or equivalent tools for packet and protocol analysis.
• Knowledge of PON technologies and BBF network architecture standards (e.g., TR-101, TR-156, TR-178) is a plus; familiarity with the OMCI protocol (ITU-T G.988) is a nice-to-have bonus.
• Experience with cloud-based (Kubernetes) networking is a plus.
• Ability to understand technical documentation, including network protocol standards and RFCs, software and hardware configuration guides, schematics, work instructions, and test procedures.
• Ability to develop and present technical solutions to customers and internal teams.
• Experience in pre-sales technical support, including product demonstrations and feasibility analysis, is a plus.
• Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
• Business-level fluency in English, written and verbal, is a must.
Travel

• Travel to customer labs or deployment sites for integration, testing, or investigation purposes, frequency varies and may reach up to 50%.

• Occasional travel to Harmonic corporate offices for training.

Pay & Benefits -
For this role, the estimated base salary range is between CAD 105,000 - CAD 120,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market, location, and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Airbyte is the data and action layer for AI agents. We give agents fast, accurate, authenticated access to business data across hundreds of sources, so they can discover the entities that matter, reason over real-time context, and take action in the systems they read from, not just observe them.

We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.

Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.

 

THE ROLE:

As Airbyte's Accounting Manager, you’ll own the day-to-day of our accounting operations and reporting - and you’ll help us rebuild how that work gets done, replacing manual processes and outsourced accounting firm dependencies with clean, automated, in-house workflows.

We currently run a lean model with an outsourced accounting firm and a Senior Accountant. You’ll manage both, and over time help us bring accounting back in-house - taking ownership of more of the function as you go. You’ll report directly to the Director of Finance (who reports to the COO) as a thought partner on automating our close and operations, and you’ll have real room to experiment with modern tooling and AI to do it.

We're hiring someone with the intention of investing in their long-term growth. As the business evolves, this role is expected to take on increasing ownership and responsibility, with the opportunity to help shape and ultimately lead the accounting function over time. If you want to build a modern accounting function - not just maintain one - this is that seat.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Run the month-end close, and continuously shorten and automate it.

- Manage a Senior Accountant and our outsourced accounting team, and help lead the transition of work in-house over time.

- Prepare for and support external audits, including documentation, technical accounting memos, and internal controls.

- Apply and help maintain technical accounting policies, including revenue recognition under ASC 606 and lease accounting under ASC 842.

- Evaluate, implement, and optimize accounting systems and workflows - reducing manual work and building for scale.

- Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Support to keep accounting accurate across our business systems.

- Act as a thought partner to the Director of Finance on automating close and operations, including using AI where it drives real impact.

- Grow into broader ownership of the accounting function as the business scales.

- Perform and review detailed flux and variance analysis, identifying and proactively investigating unexpected trends or anomalies in our financials.

 

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

- 5+ years of progressive accounting experience.

- Ideally a Big 4 audit and startup combined background.

- Working knowledge of US GAAP, including revenue recognition (ASC 606) and lease accounting (ASC 842).

- Strong systems instincts - you’ve evaluated, implemented, or redesigned accounting workflows and tools, and you reach for automation before manual effort.

- Tech-savvy and genuinely AI-curious - you’ve explored (or are eager to explore) how automation and AI can transform accounting, and you like building.

Description: Turning on a refrigerator remotely requires the boat to be connected. However, boats are often located in archipelagos or remote areas with poor network coverage. This thesis project explores Edge Computing and investigates how logic and system states can be managed locally on the boat while synchronizing intelligently with the cloud.

Research questions:

• How do you design a system (Digital Twin) where a user can send the command "Turn on the AC" from an app, have the command placed in a queue, and execute it automatically as soon as the boat regains network connectivity?

• How should conflicts be handled (for example, if someone manually turned on the AC while on board)?

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
Kunai builds full-stack technology solutions for banks, credit and payment networks, infrastructure providers, and their customers. Together, we are changing the world’s relationship with financial services. At Kunai , we help our clients modernize, capitalize on emerging trends, and evolve their business for the coming decades by remaining tech-agnostic and human-centered.

We're building a new abstraction layer that gives applications - regardless of language - safe, consistent access to data living in our core banking system, without those applications ever needing to interact with the core directly. This layer sits between our banking core and every downstream data product and application that consumes its data.
You'll join as a Senior Backend Engineer working primarily in Go. You'll partner closely with our Profile Engineer, who owns the core-side implementation in FIS Profile's proprietary scripting language (PSL), while you build the integration layer that sits in front of it. You won't be writing new product-facing API endpoints - your focus is the layer underneath: data extraction, modeling, and the access patterns that let other teams' applications consume this data safely.
What you'll do

• Design and build Go services that transform data surfaced from our core banking system into a consistent model usable by any downstream application

• Partner with our Profile engineer and data engineers to define clean extraction points from the core - you won't write PSL yourself, but you'll need to understand enough of the data model and business-process mapping to design the right abstraction around it

• Build and maintain the access layer (APIs and/or event streams) that lets other teams integrate with this data without touching the core directly

• Enforce data integrity, access boundaries, and schema versioning so changes in the core don't ripple out to every consuming application

• Integrate with existing API endpoints maintained by other teams - this role extends and consumes APIs, it does not originate new product-facing endpoints

• Help define whether new data products are served via batch, event-driven (e.g. Kafka/CDC), or real-time APIs, depending on freshness requirements

• Collaborate with data engineers on the same team to make new data products viewable/queryable downstream

What we're looking for

• 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with Go as your primary/preferred language

• Experience building integration, abstraction, or platform layers that sit between legacy systems of record and modern consuming applications

• Comfort working with transactional systems and/or payments

• Experience with event-driven architectures like Kafka and CDC pipelines

• Prior exposure to legacy core banking systems is a plus, though we don't expect Go engineers to write Profile/PSL themselves

• Experience provisioning cloud services in AWS or other providers

US Remote · Compensation depends on location but is generally between 140 - 170k base with an up-to 20% annual bonus.

Our success over the past 20 years is rooted in our exceptional team, which thrives in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning.

We are proud to offer our employees a range of benefits, including competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, and flexible work arrangements, all designed to help them thrive. As we continue to expand, we remain committed to cultivating an environment where people feel valued, have a voice, and are given the tools to grow-both personally and professionally-while pushing the boundaries of innovation in the fintech industry.

title: Barnläkare för digitalt arbete
description:
Vill du vara med och förändra vården?
Då vill vi prata med dig!
Om den digitala tjänsten
Hej! Jag heter Maria Lundqvist och är verksamhetschef på Kry Digital. Jag tror på en enkel sak: vården blir bättre när vi vågar göra den annorlunda. I vår digitala tjänst jobbar vi nära varandra med hjälp av våra digitala verktyg. Det är lika självklart att be om hjälp som att komma med en ny idé. Vi är ett team på 140 medarbetare som delar samma övertygelse - att hög tillgänglighet, ny teknik och ett genuint fokus på kvalitet och patientnöjdhet inte är motsatser. Det bevisar vi varje dag.

Varför Kry ?
Vi har förändrat hur vård bedrivs i Sverige i över tio år. Gjort den digital, tillgänglig och mer jämlik. Men vi är inte klara och det är poängen.På Kry tror vi att det modigaste du kan göra i vårdbranschen är att vara snäll. Och att de som kan vården ska styra den. Hos oss får du mandat att göra det - ta det, be inte om det.

Vad du faktiskt gör
Du genomför digitala konsultationer via vår plattform och du gör det på ett sätt som får barnpatienter att känna sig sedda. Du kan även komma att avlasta våra vårdcentraler digitalt och journalföra i regionala system. Arbetet är brett. Du utreder, bedömer och behandlar barn upp till 18 år: akuta bedömningar, långsiktig uppföljning, digitalt och fysiskt. Du samarbetar nära vårdcentralerna och övriga vårdflöden. Vi tror inte att digital och fysisk vård är varandras motpoler. De är varandras förutsättningar. Dina erfarenheter är med och formar hur vi arbetar, idag och framåt. Det kallar vi Kry -modellen.Läs mer om den här.

Vad vi förväntar oss av dig

• Specialist i barn- och ungdomsmedicin.

• Meriterande att kunna ta emot vuxna patienter.

• Du tar ansvar och får saker gjorda.

• Du trivs i förändring och ser det som kul.

• Du levererar vård med hög kvalitet och sätter patienten först.

• Du är flytande i både svenska och engelska.

Ersättning:Timlön eller konsultarvode
Arbetstid:Vardagar dagtid, kvällar efter 19 samt helg

title: Community Engagement Manager, Data Centers (Indiana & Kentucky)
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.

We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Indiana and Kentucky to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.

You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.

You will travel regularly within Indiana and Kentucky, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets.

Key responsibilities

•
Build and maintain trusted, sustained relationships with county commissioners and councils, Kentucky fiscal courts and judge-executives, mayors and city councils, plan commissions and zoning boards, state and regional economic development organizations, community groups, civic leaders, educational institutions, and workforce partners in the Indiana and Kentucky data center markets you cover

•
Develop and execute a community engagement strategy for each of your markets, spanning site selection, pre-development, construction, and ongoing operations

•
Build external coalitions, host education and listening sessions, and design local solutions that deliver real benefits to the communities where we operate

•
Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media

•
Monitor community sentiment and local political dynamics, and advise internal teams on risks, opportunities, and the right pace and posture for engagement

•
Partner with the Real Estate and Infrastructure team to bring community input into how projects are planned, communicated, and delivered, not just how they are announced

•
Work with the Communications team to develop proactive, locally relevant messaging

•
Coordinate charitable giving, community investment, and economic development commitments in your markets, including managing nonprofit partner relationships

•
Partner with the Energy and Sustainability team to explain our approach to environmental stewardship and respond to questions about power, water, and land use, including how large electricity needs are served by local utilities and rural electric cooperatives

•
Build a community engagement playbook and repeatable processes that scale as Anthropic's infrastructure footprint grows

Minimum qualifications

•
Experience in community affairs, public affairs, economic development, government relations, local or state government, or a closely related field

•
Direct experience working for or engaging with county and municipal governments and

Somos un grupo tecnológico multinacional especializado en transformación digital, con más de 3.500 profesionales , más de 1.000 clientes y más de 30 años de historia.

Por eso buscamos un/a Global Head of People & Culture .

La posición tendrá responsabilidad sobre People & Culture para todo el Grupo knowmad mood , aunque por dimensión y peso dentro de la organización tendrá un foco especialmente relevante en España .

Buscamos a alguien que nos ayude a construir la organización que knowmad mood necesita para su siguiente etapa.

El objetivo será doble: hacer que People funcione cada vez mejor hoy y construir la organización global que necesitaremos mañana , acompañando la evolución de knowmad mood hacia un grupo internacional cada vez más conectado, escalable y orientado a las personas.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backoffice Platform
description:
Our everyday digital experiences are in the middle of a realtime revolution: chatting alongside a livestream, getting realtime financial updates, or working with colleagues in a shared online space. Consumers now expect realtime as standard, and Ably powers a large part of it.

We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably .

Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There's still so much to build, and we'd like your help with it.

About this role
Ably 's back office platform is where every customer account is managed. It holds the packages, entitlements and limits that determine what each of our customers can do, and it runs the tooling our Finance, Customer Success and Support teams rely on every day.
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a platform the whole business depends on, with the scope to decide how it should work rather than maintain someone else's decisions. You'll be hands-on across entitlements, administration tooling and billing, working closely with our Head of Infrastructure and our Developer Experience team, and directly with the teams who use what you build.
We work in an AI-first engineering culture: AI tools are part of how we plan, prototype, and iterate, though engineers own every technical decision, and human judgment is the quality bar that everything is measured against.
Day to day you will

•
Run the back office platform. You'll look after the systems holding every customer's packages, entitlements, limits and billing, along with the tooling Finance, Customer Success and Support use daily.

•
Solve problems, not tickets. You'll be handed a problem, usually described by the people living with it rather than specified in advance, and you'll own the design as well as the delivery.

•
Make admin work for the people who use it. Staff should be able to see what a customer has bought, how they're billed and what limits they have, make a change, and trust the result, without needing to understand our internal models.

•
Partner across the company. Finance, Customer Success, Support and Engineering are all your users. You'll learn their processes well enough to question a requirement rather than just build it.

•
Champion AI-assisted development. You'll use LLMs and AI tools for planning, spikes, code and docs to accelerate velocity, while owning correctness and architectural quality yourself.

•
Make the systems explain themselves. Why a customer has the limits they have, and what produced an invoice, should be answerable without an engineer digging through code.

•
Set the testing bar. You'll decide what good looks like where mistakes cost money, build the harness to match, and hold the line on production readiness.

We'd love to talk if you have

• Experience working in large, established codebases, and the judgement to tell when a system should be extended, reworked, or replaced outright, including the confidence to say so unprompted. Ruby on Rails will help you get to grips with what we have today, though we care more about your range than any one language, and what you build here may well not be Rails.

• A track record of shaping architecture inside a system you inherited, including the data ownership decisions that come with drawing a boundary.

• The ability to self-start, work through ambiguity, and make good decisions without a lot of hand-holding. We'll bring you problems, not designs, and we'd expect you to push back when the answer is to change a process rather than write code.

• An AI-first mindset. You see LLMs and AI tools

- Experience working in a fast-moving technology company or startup.

• Operate effectively within an embedded, highly collaborative environment, partnering across Unilever and WPP Unite teams.

Skills & Experience
